sources.entry: PieFed - A link aggregator / reddit clone for the fediverse (alternative to Reddit). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.name: PieFed
summary.one_liner: PieFed is an open-source, federated link aggregator and forum for the fediverse, built on ActivityPub and written in Python.
use_cases: Joining an online community without ads or algorithmic feeds
Self-hosting a federated forum for a community
Sharing and discussing links across fediverse servers
Contributing to or customizing open-source Python social software
Running a personal or organizational ActivityPub instance
summary.what_it_does: PieFed is a link aggregator and forum for building or joining communities on the fediverse. Posts made on one server can be seen, shared, and discussed by users on other servers because it runs on the ActivityPub open standard. The project states it has no ads, no tracking, and no algorithmic feed, so users build their own feed. Server admins can join the project's main instance (join.piefed.social) or self-host their own. The codebase is Python-based and released under the AGPL license, with developer documentation and a video introduction to the code.
notable: Federated via ActivityPub, so posts are visible across servers in the fediverse
No ads, tracking, or algorithmic feed; users control their own feed
Python codebase under AGPL-3.0 with developer docs and video introduction
Can self-host or join existing instances such as join.piefed.social
caveats: Page does not state a platform list beyond the web; Docker is mentioned only via the awesome-selfhosted listing
